svg.title: DualMind Arena — architecture: Request path
svg.desc: DualMind Arena architecture — Request path, top to bottom. A user prompt enters the Edge layer at Cloudflare CDN, which absorbed a traffic spike of 5,000+ requests; then the API layer, a stateless .NET Web API that scales out; then the Gateway layer, Cloudflare AI Gateway, which handles rate limits, caching and per-request logs. The gateway fans the prompt out to Model A and Model B, head to head (versus), in a blind Models layer where both identities are hidden. Both answers go to a community vote, and the Data layer — Supabase (PostgreSQL) — stores the result and ranks the live leaderboard. Links to the documentation at docs.dualmindlab.tech.
